title: PT Citra Plastik Makmur – Plastic Injection
paragraphs: Having more than 20 years of experience in plastic injection industry, our Director Mr Teguh Nurdin started to develop Suzuki motorcycle’s mirror in 1997.
Our VA/VE ideas have brought significant design simplification. For instance, we simplify three models of clamp wiring harness by using only one mold.
As a result, CPM gains trust from our customers and has grown to supply various plastic parts with 55 injection machines, ranging from 40 to 850 ton.
